findings.summary: Environment normalization is duplicated instead of shared with the server observability path.
findings.consequence: A future environment alias or backend enum change can be applied to request events but missed for browser intake forwarding, producing inconsistent observability environment values across the same frontend service.
findings.evidence: The owned normalizeEnvironment function begins at line 293 and maps stage/staging/production/default. The same mapping exists independently in server/utils/observability.ts lines 97-101 for request observability, while both functions target generated EventEnvironment values from the same observability schema boundary.
findings.recommendation: Move environment normalization into a shared server observability helper and import it from both request-event construction and browser-intake forwarding, preserving the same EventEnvironment return type.
